title: backfill.mjs entities live path passes no tagClaims option, so it always tags claims regardless of claims-extraction health (ISS-155's second half; the id half is fixed, the decision is still open)
evidence: scripts/backfill.mjs calls promoteAndPersistEntities(TENANT, sess._id, root, db) with no options, unlike indexSession which passes tagClaims:false on a degraded claims run (ISS-056 / C5). Not changed by the ISS-155 fix: whether a manual backfill should honour that flag is a decision, not a one-line fix.
fix_direction: Decide and record whether backfill should thread tagClaims (it has no claims-health signal of its own), then pin it. Medium: verify inside the next unit that touches backfill.mjs.
